title: PBR Material Comparison Sphere Grid with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that renders an interactive PBR material comparison sphere grid with parameter sliders and full undo/redo support.

## Scene Setup
- Create a 4x4 grid of 16 spheres (SphereGeometry radius 0.8, 64 segments) arranged with spacing 2.5 units apart, centered at origin.
- Each sphere uses THREE.MeshStandardMaterial. Rows represent increasing roughness (0.0, 0.33, 0.66, 1.0 top-to-bottom). Columns represent increasing metalness (0.0, 0.33, 0.66, 1.0 left-to-right).
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 0, 18), FOV 45, looking at origin.
- Lighting: One DirectionalLight (intensity 1.5, color white) at (5, 10, 7), one HemisphereLight (sky: 0x8888ff, ground: 0x443322, intensity 0.6), and one PointLight (intensity 0.8, color 0xffeedd) at (-5, 3, 5).
- Background color: 0x1a1a2e.
- Add OrbitControls for camera rotation.

## Selection System
- Clicking on a sphere selects it. The selected sphere gets a visible emissive highlight (emissive color 0x335599, emissiveIntensity 0.3). Previously selected sphere loses its highlight.
- Track selectedSphereIndex (0-15, row-major order, -1 if none selected).

## DOM UI - Parameter Sliders
- Create a fixed panel (top-right, 280px wide, dark semi-transparent background, white text) with:
  - Title: 'PBR Parameters'
  - Range slider for 'Roughness' (min 0, max 1, step 0.01, id='roughnessSlider')
  - Range slider for 'Metalness' (min 0, max 1, step 0.01, id='metalnessSlider')
  - Range slider for 'Emissive Intensity' (min 0, max 1, step 0.01, id='emissiveSlider')
  - Color picker for 'Base Color' (id='colorPicker', default '#cc6633')
  - Each slider shows its current numeric value in a span next to it.
  - An 'Apply to Selected' button (id='applyBtn') that applies current slider/picker values to the selected sphere.
  - An 'Apply to All' button (id='applyAllBtn') that applies current slider/picker values to ALL 16 spheres.
  - An 'Undo' button (id='undoBtn') and 'Redo' button (id='redoBtn').
  - A 'Reset All' button (id='resetBtn') that restores all spheres to their original row/column-based roughness/metalness values, base color #cc6633, emissiveIntensity 0.

## Undo/Redo System
- Maintain an undo stack and redo stack. Each entry stores a snapshot of ALL 16 spheres' material parameters: { roughness, metalness, color (hex string), emissiveIntensity }.
- Before any Apply/ApplyAll/Reset action, push the current state onto the undo stack and clear the redo stack.
- Undo: pop from undo stack, push current state to redo stack, restore popped state.
- Redo: pop from redo stack, push current state to undo stack, restore popped state.
- Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Z for undo, Ctrl+Y for redo.
- Max undo stack size: 50 entries.

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose and continuously update:
- sphereCount: number of spheres (16)
- selectedSphereIndex: currently selected sphere index (-1 if none)
- spheres: array of 16 objects, each with { roughness: number, metalness: number, color: string (hex like '#cc6633'), emissiveIntensity: number }
- undoStackSize: number of entries in undo stack
- redoStackSize: number of entries in redo stack
- sliderValues: { roughness: number, metalness: number, emissiveIntensity: number, color: string }
- lastAction: string ('none'|'apply'|'applyAll'|'undo'|'redo'|'reset'|'select')
- cameraDistance: distance from camera to origin (rounded to 2 decimals)
- totalEmissiveIntensity: sum of all 16 spheres' emissiveIntensity values (rounded to 4 decimals)

Update __3D_STATE__ on every frame in the animation loop and after every user action.
physics_constraints: Material parameter conservation: roughness and metalness must remain clamped [0,1]. Emissive intensity clamped [0,1]. Undo/redo must perfectly restore all 16 sphere parameters to exact prior values (epsilon < 0.001). After reset, sphere[i] roughness = Math.floor(i/4) * 0.33 (capped at 1.0 for row 3), metalness = (i%4) * 0.33 (capped at 1.0 for col 3). Undo stack + redo stack entry counts must be consistent: after N actions with no undo, undoStackSize === N. After one undo, undoStackSize === N-1 and redoStackSize === 1.
